strategies.name: Recreate
strategies.description: Terminate old version before starting new version.

strategies.name: Rolling Update
strategies.description: Gradually replaces old instances with new ones.

strategies.name: Blue/Green
strategies.description: Two identical environments; switch traffic instantly via Load Balancer.

strategies.name: Canary
strategies.description: Route a small % of traffic to the new version to test stability.

logic_triggers.If_Tier_3: Default to Recreate to save costs.
logic_triggers.Cost_Impact: Blue/Green adds +100% compute cost during the release window.
